newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SPH sees better full year results.
newsitem.headline: SPH sees better full year results.

text.p: Singapore Press Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it expected better operating results for the full year ending August 31, 1997.
The newspaper group saw a 9.2 percent growth in net profit to S$172.38 million for the six months ended February 28, 1997 and a 3.4 percent rise in turnover to S$455.05 million.
The newspaper group said in a statement accompanying its results that prices of newsprint, one of its major production costs, were likely to remain stable for the rest of the year.
The group also declared a pre-tax half year dividend of S$0.12 against S$0.10 previously.
